exposure: Method of labor induction (Cook balloon vs. oxytocin)
cohort: Women undergoing trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) with an unfavorable cervix
finding: Oxytocin induction of labor was associated with a higher rate of vaginal delivery and shorter duration of labor compared to the Cook balloon in women undergoing TOLAC with an unfavorable cervix.
mod_finding: Oxytocin induction of labor was associated with a higher rate of vaginal delivery compared to the Cook balloon.
